_comment: National lines only — police, ambulance, the National Emergency Operation Centre and Hello Sarkar answer anywhere in Nepal. Copied from the Bhotekoshi desk's helplines with the same source and verification date. The Bhotekoshi-specific rescue and police lines are deliberately not carried over. Add a Gorkha district line only when it is copied from the District Administration Office or Nepal Police and its source is recorded here.
source: Nepal Police / NDRRMA published emergency numbers
